name: ad-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in Andorra for tax year 2026, read from Llei 20/2007 on SA and SL companies (as amended to Llei 17/2026), Llei 10/2012 on foreign investment, the corporate tax law and regulation, the IGI law and the social security law, as consolidated on the Portal Jurídic d'Andorra. Step-by-step: choose the SL (and single-member SLU) or the SA, minimum capital of EUR 3,000 and EUR 60,000 paid in full, contributions in cash or kind and the expert-report exceptions, name reservation, foreign-investment authorisation above 10% (2-month decision, silence means refusal), the notarial deed and the 15-day registry periods, tax (NRT) and CASS registration, then the yearly cycle: annual accounts, AGM, audit thresholds, account deposit and beneficial-owner fines, company tax, IGI and CASS filing windows, and dissolution causes including the 2026 administrative dissolution of empty companies. Use for 'set up a company in Andorra', 'Andorra SL capital', 'SL or SA in Andorra',
